in_sanskrit.name: कृतिका
in_sanskrit.meaning: कृत्त = to do, create; का = instrument, tool; कृतिका = the one who does, creates.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who does, creates, or is a tool for doing. A goddess of art, poetry, and the constellation Ursa Minor. She is also considered the goddess of the night, of darkness, and of the moon.

in_marathi.name: Kritika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Critic, observer, evaluator
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kritika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kritika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'kriti' which means 'created' or 'made'. The name is also associated with the goddess Kritika, who is a member of the Pleiades star cluster and the god of criticism. Kritika is believed to represent the power of evaluation and observation, making it an excellent choice for a child who is destined to be a thoughtful and wise observer in life.

vedic_reference.note: Kritika is the name of a constellation and a goddess in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as the wife of the god of the moon, Chandra. Kritika is also the name of a Vedic goddess of poetry and the arts. She is often depicted as the mother of the Vedas and the source of all creative inspiration.
